class.name: arxlift2s_ros2_control/ArxX5Hardware
class.description: ARX X5 single-arm SystemInterface (Stanford arx5-sdk / Arx5JointController). Instantiate once per arm for LIFT2S: left can1, right can3. Params: robot_model (default X5), can_interface (alias can_name), control_mode full_control|position (live-switchable), joint_k_gains, joint_d_gains, gripper_kp, gripper_kd (live). Always exports MIX position/velocity/effort/kp/kd; control_mode selects write() (same contract as panthera-ht). In position, velocity is ignored and (by default) torque/effort is set to 0; if you set ``position_forward_effort=true`` effort is forwarded as torque feedforward. Gripper stays position-only. Official InterfacesThread arm path is retired from this package.

class.name: arxlift2s_ros2_control/ArxLiftHardware
class.description: ARX LIFT2S lift-column SystemInterface (Soft-P or Hybrid MIT via LiftHeadControlLoop). Exactly one joint (lift_joint); height in meters. Modes: soft_p|position (setHeight/loop) | hybrid (sendLiftHybrid; HI gravity only, ignores controller effort). Live: arx_lift.motor_mode, soft_p_kp, hybrid_kp, hybrid_kd, gravity_compensation_torque. URDF: lift_motor_mode, soft_p_kp, hybrid_kp, hybrid_kd, gravity_compensation_torque, height_rad_per_meter, robot_type=2. Exports MIX IFs for ocs2_wbc. Parks chassis on activate. Mutex: do not share can5 with official lift_controller.
